name: Seta
source: Seta clearly has some kind of plan in place, but what it is and what it will achieve no one knows. She seems to drop helpful information into Ellie's lap, but what could her ulterior motive be? The other inhabitants clearly have a strong distaste for her as she openly bullies them. She has a strong affinity with spiders.
